# Bug: CI on main was red because two tests only worked on Windows
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #157, sha256:87366f845dd877a7591dac5dc4fc5f116591dd1c3fb1f938f15e263019a403b0). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-28 (CI green on 46fdfef: both jobs succeed; scripts/check-ci-main.py, agreement rule 'CI on main is part of the line', retro seed)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** bug (process defect: a constraint did not report its own failure)
- **Milestone:** Usable v1 (shortest path to a real prototype)
- **Source:** Reported by the product owner from failure emails, 2026-10-28: about 97 of the last 100 ci runs on main failed while every local gate (Windows) passed.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Riley, I want a red CI on main to stop the loop on its own, so that a failing constraint is seen by the mob before anyone else has to tell it.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the ci workflow on ubuntu, When it runs on main, Then the test job and the usable-v1 job both succeed (the two Windows-only tests, a cmd fake model and a quoted prompt-path assertion, have a Linux branch)
  2. Given scripts/check-ci-main.py, When the latest finished run on main failed, Then it exits 1 with a stop-the-line message, and a run still in progress does not hide an earlier red one (unit tests)
  3. Given TEAM_WORKING_AGREEMENT.md, When the loop pushes, Then the rule requires the check after every push and at the start of every iteration, with red meaning no other card starts

## Context

- Root cause: the local gate runs on Windows, CI on Linux, and nothing in the loop read the remote status. Fixed in commit 46fdfef (CI green) plus the detection script and the agreement rule. Retro seed written in docs/retros/seeds.md: which other Windows-only assumptions exist, and whether a Linux container run should join the local gate.
